name: pseolint
description: Audit programmatic SEO sites for SpamBrain risk. 35 rules across 6 categories detect near-duplicates, doorway pages, thin content, and missing technical SEO.

tools.name: audit_site
tools.description: Run a full pseolint audit on a URL or directory. Returns SpamBrain Risk Score (0-100) and actionable findings.

source.description: URL or directory path to audit

sampleSize.description: Audit a random subset of N pages (0 = all)

format.description: Output format: console or json (default: console)

tools.name: explain_score
tools.description: Audit a site and explain what's driving the SpamBrain Risk Score with category breakdowns and prioritized fixes.

source.description: URL or directory path to audit

tools.name: check_page
tools.description: Quick check a single page URL against pseolint rules. Faster than a full site audit.

url.description: URL of the page to check
